lens.aperture: Wide-angle prime: F1.0; Zoom: F1.35 (W) to F4.6 (T)

field_of_view_deg: Wide-angle prime lens: 95 horizontal x 50 vertical; Zoom lens: horizontal 2 (T) to 60.9 (W), vertical 1.2 (T) to 35.3 (W)
features: Dual camera modules: wide-angle panoramic view + zoom detail capture with axis deviation self-calibration
Automatic tracking, intelligent tracking, behavior analysis (fast movement, tripwire crossing, intrusion, area entry/exit, loitering)
Crowd flow analysis (queue length, head counting, crowd flow statistics)
Vehicle color/type/model recognition and traffic flow statistics; parking violation detection
Person detection and personal attribute recognition; target attribute recognition
120 dB WDR, backlight and overcast scene adaptation
Six-axis gyroscope electronic image stabilization (EIS) with sensitivity levels
Built-in electronic compass and accelerometer for real-time PTZ direction/tilt display
Pan 0-360 deg continuous, tilt -10 to 90 deg; manual pan speed 0.1-160 deg/s, preset move speed 240 deg/s
256 preset positions including one home position; tour and park action supported
ONVIF Profile S/G/T, GA/T 1400, GB/T 28181 (2011, 2016), SDK and REST API support
Dual video streams; video bitrate up to 16 Mbps (1080P-4K)
Media stream and SD card storage encryption; video/image digital watermark
4 alarm inputs, 2 alarm outputs; RS-485 serial port; two RJ45 10M/100M adaptive Ethernet ports
White-light illumination distance 30m for color night vision, alongside 200m IR range
IK10 rated except for the viewing window; Class C anti-corrosion; 6kV surge protection
